criteria.rationale: Read the canonical milestone exit gate and its owned source implementation; the registered qualified/federated/transfer/installed journey integrations and negative cases prove the stated implementation boundary.
Resolved the canonical owned source members, terminal states and current approved proofs; no consumer task or duplicated same-slug authority is treated as owned implementation.
Inspected the bounded source regressions for wrong authority, failed external lookup, concurrent transfer and unsupported capability; current required integration and unit producers passed.
No implicit experimental adoption or fabricated historical obligation is introduced. Unobserved consumers, missing field telemetry and deferred staging remain explicit in their owning reports.
